business_problem: ServiceNow wanted to close the gap between consumer-grade self-service and the fragmented enterprise support experience, where customers and employees still had to navigate multiple portals, unclear instructions, and slow ticket-based resolution for routine work.
solution_summary: ServiceNow reworked self-service around three building blocks: AI-ready content, conversational search, and agentic workflows. Knowledge Management practices were tightened with templates, metadata, quality reviews, and feedback loops so AI Search and automation could rely on trusted content instead of duplicate or ambiguous articles. On top of that content layer, conversational AI interprets intent in natural language, searches the governed knowledge catalog, and either returns the exact answer or triggers the fix automatically. Agentic workflows and Virtual Agent then take over routine end-to-end support actions, using policy guardrails, role-based permissions, confidence thresholds, and privacy-by-design controls so automation remains explainable and auditable. This turned self-service into a coordinated support continuum where content, search, and action all run on the ServiceNow AI Platform and continuously improve each other through faster article creation and frontline feedback.

data_flow: Knowledge is standardized and scored for AI readiness, then AI Search and conversational interfaces use that catalog to interpret intent and surface answers. When search alone is not enough, AI agents and Virtual Agent launch policy-governed workflows that complete the task, confirm the outcome, and feed new frontline learning back into the knowledge system.
business_outcome: ServiceNow now supports an estimated 89% of customer self-service requests with AI while maintaining 9.0 CSAT, tripled knowledge-base creation volume with 9.3/10 CSAT for AI-generated articles, and saved employees more than 2.3 million hours in 2025.

evidence_quotes: We strategically targeted AI investment across three critical areas to improve our self-service success: AI-ready content, Conversational search, Agentic workflows.
We created standardization for AI-ready content by rolling out article templates, rich categorization and meta-tagging, continuous quality reviews, feedback ratings, and tight governance.
Now, anyone can type natural language, and the AI Search does the detective work.
AI agents have tripled knowledge base creation volume, with a 9.3/10 CSAT for AI-generated articles.
Across 2025, our efforts helped save our employees over 2.3 million hours.
